parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, meaning I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. I can also call off a flight. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and while software never picks a drone or a way for us, we do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
